title: PURA: Video Token Pruning via Unified Spatiotemporal Redundancy Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2611.34521v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video large language models incur substantial inference costs from long visual token sequences. Existing video token compression methods mitigate these costs by exploiting spatial redundancy within frames and temporal redundancy across frames. However, many approaches impose predefined processing orders or fixed allocation ratios for spatial and temporal compression, limiting their ability to adapt to the varying balance of spatiotemporal redundancy across videos. To address this limitation, we propose PURA, a training-free method that prunes visual tokens through unified spatiotemporal redundancy assessment. For each token, PURA constructs spatial and temporal reference candidates and selects the reference with the lowest representation error across the two dimensions. translated_title: PURA：基于统一时空冗余评估的视频Token剪枝
translated_abstract: 视频大语言模型因长视觉token序列而产生高昂的推理成本。现有的视频token压缩方法通过利用帧内空间冗余和帧间时间冗余来缓解这些成本。然而，许多方法对空间和时间压缩施加预定义的处理顺序或固定的分配比例，限制了其适应不同视频中时空冗余平衡变化的能力。为解决这一局限，我们提出了PURA，一种通过统一时空冗余评估来剪枝视觉token的免训练方法。对于每个token，PURA构建空间和时间参考候选，并选择在这两个维度上表示误差最低的参考。该表示误差与token重要性相结合，用于确定每个token的移除成本。为避免逐一移除最低成本token带来的时间开销……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出了一种免训练的视频token剪枝方法PURA，通过统一评估空间与时间冗余并结合token重要性来自适应地确定移除成本，克服了现有方法固定处理顺序和分配比例的局限性。
en_tdlr: PURA is a training-free video token pruning method that adaptively determines token removal costs by unified spatiotemporal redundancy assessment combined with token importance, overcoming the rigid processing orders and fixed allocation ratios of existing approaches.
